nodes.name: Frame Sense
nodes.blurb: One more row on the weapon frame, out of turn.

nodes.name: The Second Frame
nodes.blurb: And one on the chest. Your people cut brackets before they cut anything else.

nodes.name: Flush Fit
nodes.blurb: Every finished item pays a tenth more. Nothing is wasted at the joins.

nodes.name: Tighter Still
nodes.blurb: Another tenth. There is a point past which it stops being packing and starts being pride.

nodes.name: Thick Skull
nodes.blurb: Songil is survivable. Barely, and not twice in a week.

nodes.name: Corked
nodes.blurb: A strip of it, wedged where a blow lands. It comes back every fight.

nodes.name: Cave Lungs
nodes.blurb: Nine hundred feet of Deep Chocolate mine, and you never once came up early.

nodes.name: The Long Shift
nodes.blurb: Fourteen hours is a shift. Sixteen is a shift somebody is counting.

nodes.name: Handspan
nodes.blurb: You can still judge a gear by putting a hand across it. It is not a skill anybody taught you.

nodes.name: Anvil-Armed
nodes.blurb: The pit had one anvil and four hundred of you. You got your turn at it.

nodes.name: Funnel Drill
nodes.blurb: Army-issue, and it has somebody else's name filed off the side of it.

nodes.name: Jinx Read
nodes.blurb: You can tell which of the four it is before it lands. Knowing does not stop it.

nodes.name: The Fifth Frame
nodes.blurb: A row on the greaves. You walked out of the pit; you may as well arrive.
